task.title: Save the JSON document
task.shortdesc: Save a valid raw JSON document back to the canonical BPM profile.

prereq.p: The JSON document has been validated or the remaining warnings are understood.

context.p: Saving writes the raw document back through BPM normalization. The saved profile can then be opened in Guided, All settings, Compare, or export workflows.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose Save only when the top-level policies object and policy values are correct.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Wait for the saved status before leaving the route.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Reopen the profile or export policies.json when you need handoff evidence.

info.note: Saving raw JSON can change the canonical BPM profile. Validate syntax and policy values before saving.

result.p: The BPM profile stores the JSON changes in the canonical profile model.

postreq.p: Recovery: if save fails, fix validation errors or return to a previous saved profile before editing again.
